:::{#def-prediction-error}
#### Prediction error

A [prediction function](#def-prediction) $g(\Predvar)$ has as its estimand
the observed outcome $\Outvar$ of a new data point with input $\Predvar$,
not the conditional mean of that outcome.
The **prediction error** of $g$ is the prediction minus that outcome:

$$\prederr_g \eqdef g(\Predvar) - \Outvar$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-prediction-error}
#### Prediction error in the best-predictor exercise

In @exr-best-predictor,
the constant prediction $g_1(\Predvar) = 3$ has prediction error $\prederr_{g_1} = 3 - \Outvar$,
which is $3$ when $\Outvar = 0$ and $-3$ when $\Outvar = 6$.

:::
